script:
control-agent-server api GET /api/vscode/status --auth none --expect 401 --save F16.vscode-auth/status-no-key
control-agent-server api GET /api/vscode/url --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/vscode/status" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/vscode/url" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace" --auth none --jar qa-f16 --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/vscode/url" --auth none --jar qa-f16 --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized --save F16.vscode-auth/cookie-url
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/vscode/status" --auth none --jar qa-f16 --expect 401
